sent_bad: The defendant argued that attestations made by a computer program (whether attributable to an AI software or its developer) and the automated conclusions of the Roundup and Forensic Toolkit programs constituted inadmissible hearsay not covered by the business record exception.
Ultimately, the court found **no basis for reversal**, because the trial court's decision was not clearly and convincingly unsupported by the record, regardless of any weight given to the ORAS score.
